messages.author: Cedric
messages.text: Right, we're all starving and nobody has said anything useful for ten minutes. Where are we eating?

messages.author: Xavier
messages.text: Somewhere cheap please. I have like fifteen dollars until Friday and that is not a joke.

messages.author: Rahman
messages.text: I'm easy lah. Whatever everyone wants is fine with me.

messages.author: James
messages.text: As long as I can park nearby. I'm not walking twenty minutes in this heat.

messages.author: Cedric
messages.text: There's that new bak kut teh place by the canal, everyone raves about it. Pork ribs, proper broth.

messages.author: Rahman
messages.text: Sounds good, let's do that one.

messages.author: Xavier
messages.text: How much is it though? If it's twenty a head I'm out.

messages.author: James
messages.text: Should be fine. Bit salty for me but I'll manage, I'll just get the kopi.

messages.author: Cedric
messages.text: Or the hawker centre at Tekka? Everyone gets what they want and it's eight bucks.

messages.author: Xavier
messages.text: Tekka. Obviously Tekka. Why are we even discussing this.

messages.author: Rahman
messages.text: Ah, Tekka works well for me actually — there are stalls there I can eat at.

messages.author: Nurul
messages.text: Hello! Before anything else you should know I only eat halal, I earn about three thousand a month, and I'm on a rotating shift roster this quarter.

messages.author: Cedric
messages.text: ...Right. Good afternoon to you too. I was going to ask how your week has been.

messages.author: Nurul
messages.text: Long. Two doubles back to back. How's the shop?

messages.author: Cedric
messages.text: Busy in a good way. New Ethiopian beans came in, you'd like them.

messages.author: Nurul
messages.text: I'll come by when the roster lets me. Save me one.
